svg.title: An unhurried evening in Bombay
svg.desc: Original object-based vector illustration. Two adult friends share wine and whisky on a waterfront terrace during golden hour. Behind them stand the Gateway of India and the Taj Mahal Palace hotel. Every person, garment, facial feature, glass, boat, architectural detail and reflection is built from editable SVG shapes; there are no raster images, traced pixels or embedded bitmaps.
